'''Thornshade Decanters''' are consumable [[:Category:Tools|Tool]] items that grant a [[Thornshades|buff]] upon being consumed.

== ''Obtainment'' ==
Brewed in a Brewing Stand from [[Thornshade#Thornshade Berry|Thornshade Berries]] and Awkward Potions.

{{Crafting
|r1_resultimage=Thornshade_Decanter.png

|r1_ing1=[[Thornshade#Thornshade Berry|Thornshade Berry]] (1)

}}

== ''Usage'' ==
When consumed, it bestows the [[Thornshades]] status effect for 20 seconds. Consuming a Decanter again within those 20 seconds will ''not'' cause the duration to be refreshed, and drinking another one after those 20 seconds is considered a second use.

Upon the third use, instead of receiving the [[Thornshades]] effect, the player will instead drip a large amount of blood particles, as a soft, crunchy sound plays. Shortly after that, a custom explosion of ringed blood particles is triggered around the player.

This will:
*Kill the player instantly, which can be counteracted by using a Totem of Undying in both hands simultaneously, consuming one or both.
*Grant the player the {{AdvancementLink|Beautiful Self-Destruction}}.
*Deal damage to mobs in a 5 block radius, with the amount ranging from 21 to 0 depending on the distance of the affected mob.
*Apply [[Thornshades]] to all mobs within a 10 block radius for about half a minute.

Once such an explosion is triggered, this Item will become useless until you die, which in most cases will happen alongside the explosion.

== ''Trivia'' ==
*Dying to the Thornshade explosion attributes the kill to the last entity that hit the player.
*Switching from Creative to Spectator mode while drinking the Decanter will consume it like in survival.
